title: Furnish it!
objectives: describe furniture placement using there is/are and prepositions

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Furnish it!.
Welcome to today's lesson: Furnish it!! Today we will practice how to name items of furniture.

elements.content: name items of furniture; describe furniture placement using there is/are and prepositions

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: bed, sofa, table, chair, desk, lamp

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: In my new room, there is a cozy bed, a wardrobe, and a nice carpet on the floor.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
Let's furnish the room. There is a big sofa next to the table. Put the lamp on the desk.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Describe how you want to furnish your living room or bedroom.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: name items of furniture, describe furniture placement using there is/are and prepositions.
